provider: Idaho Department of Insurance — filed SHORT-TERM (purchase/closing) escrow rates, statewide by county and licensed title agent

settlementFee.note: Regulator-compiled disclosure of every licensed Idaho title agent's filed escrow (settlement) rate structure under IDAPA 18.05.01.022, which requires annual filing (due March 15, effective April 15) of minimum escrow rates by county. This is the closest analog to a settlement-fee schedule found for Idaho -- structured as Base Rate + Rate per $1,000 of price/loan + Minimum Rate, filed separately for purchase and refinance where the agent files both.
settlementFee.formula: Escrow fee = Base Rate + (Rate per $1,000 x price/loan amount in thousands), subject to the filed Minimum Rate.

bundlingNotes: Footnote on the source document: 'Escrow services may be offered or conducted in other counties within Idaho.' No further itemization (doc prep, courier, wire, etc.) is broken out in this filing -- it is a base+per-thousand+minimum escrow-fee structure only, filed by the title agent as its escrow closing charge, distinct from the title insurance premium.
transactionContext: Standard purchase (short-term) escrow/closing fee, tiered to sale price / loan amount, by county. Refinance filed separately where noted. Covers Ada (Boise), Kootenai (Coeur d'Alene), Bonneville (Idaho Falls), Twin Falls, and Bannock (Pocatello) counties; full 44-county statewide table exists in the source but only the 5 target metro counties are extracted here.

provider: Idaho Department of Insurance — filed LONG-TERM (contract/installment) escrow rates, statewide by county and licensed title agent

settlementFee.note: Companion regulator filing to the short-term escrow rates, covering long-term/contract escrow servicing (e.g., land-contract or seller-financed installment escrow), a different product from a standard purchase closing. Included for completeness since it is filed under the same IDAPA 18.05.01.022 regime and is a genuine dollar-denominated escrow rate structure.
settlementFee.formula: Base Rate + (Rate per $1,000) + Minimum Rate; 'Rates Do Not Include Miscellaneous Long Term or Other Escrow Servicing Fees' per the source document.

bundlingNotes: Explicitly excludes 'Miscellaneous Long Term or Other Escrow Servicing Fees' per the source document -- these are base contract-escrow-setup rates only, not the full servicing cost.
transactionContext: Long-term/contract (installment) escrow servicing, not a standard one-time purchase closing. Recorded for completeness; not used in the standard purchase/refinance service-stack range comparison.
